opportunity.name: Maintenance Knowledge Chatbox
opportunity.target_workflow: Troubleshooting equipment alarms and finding maintenance procedures
opportunity.proposed_ai_capability: RAG-powered QA over maintenance manuals, alarm codes, and incident reports, with source citations
opportunity.expected_business_value: Reduce downtime and repetitive senior engineer interruptions; speed up new operator onboarding
opportunity.key_risk: Incorrect retrieval due to poor document quality or ambiguous queries
opportunity.human_approval_requirement: System must flag safety-critical actions for supervisor review; never bypass interlocks
opportunity.required_data: Machine maintenance manuals, alarm code tables, SOPs, past incident reports
opportunity.japan_enterprise_fit: Directly addresses labour shortage and knowledge silos; aligns with METI's DX productivity push
opportunity.why_now: Japan’s urgent need to counter workforce decline in manufacturing; mature RAG technology enables quick implementation

feasibility.name: Maintenance Knowledge Chatbox
key_risks: Incorrect retrieval due to poor document quality or ambiguous queries
Human approval and audit logging should be included before any production use.
required_next_validation: Review human approval boundary with business owner.

opportunity.name: Smart Escalation Decision Support
opportunity.target_workflow: Deciding when to escalate an alarm or quality issue to supervisor
opportunity.proposed_ai_capability: Rule-based engine combined with LLM reasoning over alarm severity and quality thresholds, providing recommendation with justification
opportunity.expected_business_value: Reduce inconsistent escalation decisions and prevent safety/quality oversights
opportunity.key_risk: System suggests wrong escalation level, leading to critical delay or unnecessary stop
opportunity.human_approval_requirement: Final decision always by human; system only advises; must not override supervisor
opportunity.required_data: Alarm code tables, quality inspection checklists, historical incident reports with escalation outcomes
opportunity.japan_enterprise_fit: Reinforces kaizen and safety culture; aligns with governance principles applied in manufacturing
opportunity.why_now: Scattered knowledge causes ad-hoc escalation; AI can codify best practices and ensure consistency

opportunity.name: Quality Inspection Guide Chatbox
opportunity.target_workflow: Quality-control staff performing inspections and interpreting specification limits
opportunity.proposed_ai_capability: RAG-based chatbox delivering relevant inspection steps, tolerance limits, and troubleshooting for out-of-spec conditions, with links to SOPs
opportunity.expected_business_value: Faster correct interpretation of specs, reduced misjudgments, consistent quality checks
opportunity.key_risk: Misinterpretation of ambiguous spec descriptions leading to incorrect pass/fail decisions
opportunity.human_approval_requirement: Quality-critical decisions (e.g., waiving a defect) must be approved by supervisor; system only gives reference
opportunity.required_data: Quality inspection checklists, product specification documents, past inspection results
opportunity.japan_enterprise_fit: Meets Japanese manufacturing’s high-quality standards; fits DX-driven process standardization
opportunity.why_now: Rising quality demands and workforce variability make consistent guidance essential

opportunity.name: Multilingual Operator Training Assistant
opportunity.target_workflow: On-the-job training for new operators, especially foreign trainees, on SOPs and safety checks
opportunity.proposed_ai_capability: Dual-language (Japanese + simple English) explanation of standard procedures and safety steps, generated from SOPs and FAQs
opportunity.expected_business_value: Fast and safe onboarding of diverse workforce; reduce trainer burden
opportunity.key_risk: Simplified instructions may omit critical context; reliance on AI without hands-on practice
opportunity.human_approval_requirement: Training must be supervised by experienced operator until competency confirmed; system must not replace hands-on training
opportunity.required_data: Training FAQs, SOPs, safety manuals, visual aids if available
opportunity.japan_enterprise_fit: Addresses language barrier in factories; supports ‘all-employee enablement’ in DX strategy
opportunity.why_now: Growing foreign worker employment in Japanese manufacturing; need for accessible, consistent training tools
